title: Can I DISMANTLE Drawback Chess?
summary: Drawback Chess vs random humans: each side has a secret drawback. Seen: Reflective and Flatterer.
rules: Standard board/pieces; each player gets a hidden drawback.
No check; win by capturing the king.
Reflective: you can only move non-pawns to squares whose reflection across the center line is occupied.
Flatterer: if your opponent moves a pawn you must move a pawn; if a non-pawn, a non-pawn.
